note: Section names and weights come from each exam's public outline. The concepts are Polymath's own topic list. No real exam questions are included or used.

concepts.title: IAM policy evaluation
concepts.objective: Determine whether a request is allowed when identity policies, resource policies and explicit denies combine.

concepts.title: Network ACLs and security groups
concepts.objective: Diagnose traffic blocked by stateless network ACL rules and stateful security group rules.

concepts.title: S3 Object Lock retention modes
concepts.objective: Choose a retention mode that meets a compliance requirement for immutable storage.

concepts.title: RDS Multi-AZ and read replicas
concepts.objective: Choose between Multi-AZ deployments and read replicas for availability or read scaling.

concepts.title: Decoupling with SQS
concepts.objective: Apply SQS standard or FIFO queues and visibility timeouts to decouple a workload.

concepts.title: Route 53 routing and failover
concepts.objective: Select a Route 53 routing policy and health check for a failover requirement.

concepts.title: EC2 Auto Scaling policies
concepts.objective: Choose a scaling policy that matches a predictable or variable load pattern.

concepts.title: CloudFront caching
concepts.objective: Use CloudFront to reduce latency and origin load for static and dynamic content.

concepts.title: S3 storage classes and lifecycle rules
concepts.objective: Choose storage classes and lifecycle transitions for a known access pattern.

concepts.title: EC2 purchase options
concepts.objective: Choose among On-Demand, Savings Plans, Reserved and Spot capacity for a workload.

exams.name: CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701)
exams.version_note: V7 retires in English on June 11, 2027. V8 is already available.

concepts.title: Perfect forward secrecy
concepts.objective: Select a key exchange that protects past sessions if a long-term key is later exposed.

concepts.title: Injection attacks
concepts.objective: Identify an injection attack from evidence and choose the control that prevents it.

concepts.title: Social engineering techniques
concepts.objective: Distinguish phishing, pretexting and related techniques in a described incident.

concepts.title: Network segmentation
concepts.objective: Apply segmentation and zero trust ideas to limit lateral movement.

concepts.title: RPO and RTO
concepts.objective: Apply recovery point and recovery time objectives to a business scenario.

concepts.title: Incident response phases
concepts.objective: Choose the right next step for the current phase of an incident.

concepts.title: Multifactor authentication
concepts.objective: Determine whether a login design uses truly different authentication factors.

concepts.title: Log and alert analysis
concepts.objective: Use logs and alerts to separate a real event from a false positive.

concepts.title: Risk treatment
concepts.objective: Choose accept, avoid, transfer or mitigate for a described risk.

concepts.title: Data roles and responsibilities
concepts.objective: Assign data owner, controller, processor and custodian responsibilities.

concepts.title: Shared responsibility model
concepts.objective: Determine who is responsible for a task under IaaS, PaaS and SaaS.

concepts.title: IaaS, PaaS and SaaS
concepts.objective: Match a business need to the right cloud service type.

concepts.title: Consumption-based pricing
concepts.objective: Explain how consumption pricing changes capital and operational expense.

concepts.title: Regions and availability zones
concepts.objective: Choose a deployment across zones or regions for a resilience need.

concepts.title: Storage redundancy options
concepts.objective: Select LRS, ZRS, GRS or GZRS for an availability and durability requirement.

concepts.title: Azure compute options
concepts.objective: Choose among virtual machines, containers, App Service and Functions.

concepts.title: Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access
concepts.objective: Apply identity and Conditional Access features to an access requirement.

concepts.title: Azure Policy and RBAC
concepts.objective: Choose between controlling what resources may be and what people may do.

concepts.title: Resource locks
concepts.objective: Apply CanNotDelete or ReadOnly locks and predict their effect.

concepts.title: Cost management tools
concepts.objective: Choose the right tool to estimate, track or limit Azure spending.

concepts.title: Kubernetes RBAC
concepts.objective: Choose Roles, ClusterRoles and bindings that grant the required access.

concepts.title: Upgrading with kubeadm
concepts.objective: Put the steps of a kubeadm cluster upgrade in the right order.

concepts.title: etcd backup and restore
concepts.objective: Choose the correct approach to snapshot and restore etcd.

concepts.title: Taints and tolerations
concepts.objective: Diagnose and fix a Pod that cannot be scheduled because of a taint.

concepts.title: NetworkPolicy
concepts.objective: Choose a policy that isolates Pods as required.

concepts.title: Service types
concepts.objective: Select ClusterIP, NodePort or LoadBalancer for an access requirement.

concepts.title: PersistentVolume binding and reclaim
concepts.objective: Predict PV and PVC state from access modes, storage classes and reclaim policy.

concepts.title: Diagnosing Pod states
concepts.objective: Find the cause of a Pending, CrashLoopBackOff or ImagePullBackOff Pod.

concepts.title: Diagnosing a NotReady node
concepts.objective: Choose the next diagnostic step for a node reporting NotReady.

concepts.title: Diagnosing a Service with no endpoints
concepts.objective: Trace why a Service does not reach its Pods.

exams.name: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer
exams.version_note: Weights are from Salesforce's Trailhead certification prep module. The full exam guide page could not be read automatically.

concepts.title: Governor limits and bulkification
concepts.objective: Find the code pattern that exceeds a limit and choose the bulk-safe fix.

concepts.title: Lookup and master-detail relationships
concepts.objective: Choose a relationship type from its sharing, deletion and roll-up behavior.

concepts.title: SOQL relationship queries
concepts.objective: Write or read parent-to-child and child-to-parent SOQL correctly.

concepts.title: Order of execution
concepts.objective: Predict what runs, and what runs again, when a record is saved.

concepts.title: Trigger context
concepts.objective: Choose before or after triggers and use their context variables correctly.

concepts.title: Asynchronous Apex
concepts.objective: Choose among future methods, Queueable, Batch and Scheduled Apex.

concepts.title: LWC component communication
concepts.objective: Choose public properties, events or a message service between components.

concepts.title: Lightning data access with wire
concepts.objective: Use the wire service and cacheable Apex methods correctly.

concepts.title: Apex test data and isolation
concepts.objective: Apply test setup, isolation, startTest and stopTest correctly.

concepts.title: Deployment tools and sandboxes
concepts.objective: Choose a sandbox and deployment approach and meet the test coverage rule.
